anchors.review: curated synopsis; marker verified in extracted text; not a full-page manual review

configuration.source: KDD 2020 USAD Algorithm 1; the public reference script was not re-read line by line, so results are a re-run of the algorithm rather than of the released artefact.
configuration.deviation_note: The paper's loss2 subtracts the second reconstruction term. On the pinned payloads that unbounded adversarial term drives decoder2 to diverge (median one-step reconstruction error grows from 0.16 to 2.5e8 within two epochs), so the shipped run disables the negative sign and is reported as an ablated, non-adversarial two-decoder ensemble; the divergence itself is kept as a recorded negative result.
